blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Caraga and its partners collected 6,027.92 kilograms (six tons) of non-biodegradable waste during a regionwide coastal cleanup campaign that covered 10.37 kilometers of shoreline across the region. The cleanup, conducted from September 16 to 19, 2026, gathered 1,458 volunteers who collected 761 sacks of waste from 12 coastal sites in Caraga as part of the observance of International Coastal Cleanup (ICC) Day and Philippine National Cleanup Month. Anchored on the theme “Clean Seas for Resilient Communities,” the activity brought together government agencies, local government units, schools, community […]...
